# Cell Defender adaptation note

`spaceinvaders.js` and `LICENSE` in this directory are retained as the
unmodified MIT-licensed upstream reference from dwmkerr/spaceinvaders.
Cell Defender's playable implementation lives in
`renderer/games/cellDefender/` and deliberately diverges into a host-stepped
top-down cell shooter. Its full change record is in that directory's
`MODIFICATIONS.md`.
